tool_signatures.name: add_viewport
tool_signatures.description: Put a window onto the model on a sheet: rectangle (x1,y1)-(x2,y2) in SHEET mm, at 1:scale, centred on model point (center_x,center_y). Returns the scale MEASURED back off the viewport.

tool_signatures.name: array_polar
tool_signatures.description: Polar array: copy entities count times around (cx,cy) over angle degrees. handles=['selection'] uses the GUI selection.

tool_signatures.name: array_rect
tool_signatures.description: Rectangular array of entities: rows x cols with spacings. handles=['selection'] uses the GUI selection.

tool_signatures.name: assembly_clear
tool_signatures.description: Remove instances from the assembly - their copied solids are erased from the drawing and their entries leave the manifest. names=None clears the whole assembly. Masters are never touched.

tool_signatures.name: assembly_list
tool_signatures.description: The assembly manifest: every placed instance with its pose, and whether its solid still exists in the drawing (an instance whose solid was consumed or erased is reported, not hidden - a manifest that cannot drift silently is the point of having one).

tool_signatures.name: assembly_place
tool_signatures.description: Place a COPY of a master part into the assembly, posed and registered. The master stays where it is; the copy is moved so its bounding-box anchor ('min' = the lowest corner, natural for putting a part ON something at height z; 'center') lands at (x,y,z), then rotated rot_z degrees about that point. The instance is recorded under `name` in a manifest beside the drawing, which is what contact_report and assembly_list read - the assembly is the sentence 'these copies belong together' that a bare drawing cannot say.

tool_signatures.name: bolt_circle
tool_signatures.description: N holes on a pitch-circle diameter (pcd), positions computed server-side; one call.

tool_signatures.name: bool_intersect
tool_signatures.description: Keep only the intersection of 3D solids.

tool_signatures.name: bool_subtract
tool_signatures.description: Subtract solids from solids (holes, pockets). keep = the part, subtract = the tools.

tool_signatures.name: bool_union
tool_signatures.description: Union 3D solids into one.

tool_signatures.name: boolean_verified
tool_signatures.description: Boolean that MEASURES what it did: volume before and after, and the change checked against expected_change (mm3, worked out from the shape you meant to remove or add). Catches the two failures a plain boolean reports as success: a cut that lands SHORT (the tool solid did not fully span the part, so volume drops and it looks fine - the leftover is a sliver you find in the slicer) and a cut that misses altogether (change exactly 0). Also encodes the trap that the result KEEPS the target's handle: SUBTRACT/UNION/INTERSECT write into the first solid instead of making a new entity, so (entlast) after a boolean belongs to somebody else.

tool_signatures.name: break_entity
tool_signatures.description: Break an entity between two points (opens a gap; same point twice = split only).

tool_signatures.name: center_mark
tool_signatures.description: Center-mark cross at (x,y).

tool_signatures.name: chamfer_polyline
tool_signatures.description: Chamfer (bevel) ALL corners of a polyline with equal distances.

tool_signatures.name: chamfer_solid
tool_signatures.description: Chamfer edges of a 3D solid: edges = [[x,y,z], ...], ONE point lying ON each edge to cut. A 45 deg chamfer prints without support where a fillet would need it. The edge nearest the camera wins, so set the view (view_3d) when the target is hidden behind the part. Check with solid_volume - the chamfer runs out where it meets another edge, so expect slightly less removed than distance^2/2 * length.

tool_signatures.name: check_intersection
tool_signatures.description: Do two entities intersect/overlap? Returns intersection points. The anti-collision check.

tool_signatures.name: contact_report
tool_signatures.description: Who touches whom in the assembly - and who touches NOTHING. For every pair of instances: bounding boxes first (cheap), then a real intersection on throwaway copies for the pairs whose boxes come within `clearance`. Verdicts: INTERFERENCE with the overlap volume (parts occupy the same space - an assembly error), CONTACT (boxes within clearance, no overlap - how parts that work together should read), CLEAR. Instances contacting nothing are listed as ORPHANS: a part that touches nothing either floats or lost its job to a design revision and nobody noticed - the second kind is the expensive one. Box gap is a lower bound of true distance, so a diagonal near-miss can read as CONTACT; interference volumes are exact.

tool_signatures.name: copy_entity
tool_signatures.description: Copy entity with offset (dx,dy); handle='selection' copies the user's GUI selection.

tool_signatures.name: create_block
tool_signatures.description: Define a reusable block from existing entities (they become the definition; re-place with insert_block).

tool_signatures.name: create_layer
tool_signatures.description: Create a layer with ACI color (1=red 2=yellow 3=green 4=cyan 5=blue 6=magenta 7=white) and optional lineweight in MM (0.13/0.25/0.35/0.50/0.70/1.00 - snapped to the nearest legal one).

tool_signatures.name: create_sheet
tool_signatures.description: Create/reset a paper-space sheet (layout) of size A4..A0 ready to plot 1:1: margins zeroed so paper mm = sheet mm, plot rotation cleared, auto-viewport removed. Returns the MEASURED sheet size.

tool_signatures.name: dim_aligned
tool_signatures.description: Aligned (parallel) dimension between two points; (line_x,line_y)=dimension line position. Exact coordinates unless snap=True (see dim_linear).

tool_signatures.name: dim_angular
tool_signatures.description: Angular dimension: vertex + a point on each side + dimension arc position.

tool_signatures.name: dim_diameter
tool_signatures.description: Diameter dimension (D...) on a circle/arc by handle.

tool_signatures.name: dim_linear
tool_signatures.description: Linear (horiz/vert) dimension between two points; (line_x,line_y)=dimension line position. Measures your EXACT coordinates: snap=True instead lets running object snap pull the ends onto nearby geometry (handy to dimension existing entities, but it can silently measure the wrong distance).

tool_signatures.name: dim_radius
tool_signatures.description: Radius dimension (R...) on a circle/arc by handle; angle=where it points (deg), offset=leader length factor.

tool_signatures.name: draw_arc
tool_signatures.description: Arc: center, radius, start/end angles in degrees (CCW).

tool_signatures.name: draw_batch
tool_signatures.description: Execute many drawing ops in ONE call - ALWAYS prefer this over single tools for 3+ entities. Each op is {"type":...} + params (optional "layer"). Types: line(x1,y1,x2,y2) circle(cx,cy,radius) arc(cx,cy,radius,start_angle,end_angle) rectangle(x1,y1,x2,y2) polyline(points,closed) point(x,y) text(x,y,text,height,rotation) mtext(x,y,text,width,height) ellipse(cx,cy,major_dx,major_dy,ratio) layer(name,color: set current) center_mark(x,y,size) bolt_circle(cx,cy,pcd,hole_dia,count) hatch(points,pattern,scale,angle) dim_linear/dim_aligned(x1,y1,x2,y2,line_x,line_y[,snap]) polygon(cx,cy,sides,radius) slot(x1,y1,x2,y2,width) rounded_rect(x1,y1,x2,y2,radius) symbol(symbol,x,y[,rotation,scale_denominator,layer]: a library symbol by the name a designer uses). Returns OK n=<total> h=<created handles>.

tool_signatures.name: draw_circle
tool_signatures.description: Circle at (cx,cy) with radius.

tool_signatures.name: draw_donut
tool_signatures.description: Donut (filled ring; inner_dia=0 gives a filled dot).

tool_signatures.name: draw_ellipse
tool_signatures.description: Ellipse: center (cx,cy), major-axis endpoint (major_dx,major_dy) relative to center, ratio=minor/major.

tool_signatures.name: draw_line
tool_signatures.description: Line from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2).

tool_signatures.name: draw_mtext
tool_signatures.description: Multiline text; (x,y)=top-left corner, width=wrap width.

tool_signatures.name: draw_point
tool_signatures.description: Point at (x,y).

tool_signatures.name: draw_polyline
tool_signatures.description: Polyline through [[x,y],...]; closed=true to close it.

tool_signatures.name: draw_rectangle
tool_signatures.description: Rectangle (closed polyline) between opposite corners.

tool_signatures.name: draw_spline
tool_signatures.description: Smooth spline through the given points [[x,y],...].

tool_signatures.name: draw_text
tool_signatures.description: Single-line text at (x,y); rotation in degrees.

tool_signatures.name: draw_xline
tool_signatures.description: Infinite construction line through (x,y) at angle degrees.

tool_signatures.name: drawing_info
tool_signatures.description: Total entity count (OK n=<count>).

tool_signatures.name: entity_length
tool_signatures.description: Length (and area if closed) of a curve: line, arc, circle, polyline, spline.

tool_signatures.name: entity_points
tool_signatures.description: Key points of an entity (ends/mid/center/radius/vertices): connect geometry without math.

tool_signatures.name: erase_entity
tool_signatures.description: Delete an entity by handle, or handle='selection' for the user's GUI selection.

tool_signatures.name: erase_last
tool_signatures.description: Delete the last created entity.

tool_signatures.name: explode_entity
tool_signatures.description: Explode a block/polyline/dimension into its components.

tool_signatures.name: export_dxf
tool_signatures.description: Export the drawing as ASCII DXF to path.

tool_signatures.name: export_pdf
tool_signatures.description: Export the current view to PDF, fitted to the page. For a sheet at a real scale use export_sheet_pdf instead.

tool_signatures.name: export_sheet_pdf
tool_signatures.description: Export a sheet to PDF AT ITS SCALE (unlike export_pdf, which fits the drawing to the page). Verifies by measuring the page of the PDF it produced.

tool_signatures.name: export_stl
tool_signatures.description: Export 3D solids to STL - the file a slicer needs to actually 3D print the part. handles=None exports EVERY 3D solid in the drawing; pass handles to export one part per file. quality low/medium/high/default sets the tessellation: use high for anything curved, low leaves visible facets. to_origin parks the part on the origin before writing (STL keeps world coordinates, so a part modelled far from 0,0 would otherwise land metres away in the slicer) and puts it back afterwards.

tool_signatures.name: extend_entity
tool_signatures.description: Extend: lengthen the entity (picked near the end to extend) until the boundary entity.

tool_signatures.name: extrude_profile
tool_signatures.description: Extrude a CLOSED 2D profile (polyline/circle) into a 3D solid, height along Z. The 2D->3D bridge.

tool_signatures.name: fillet_polyline
tool_signatures.description: Fillet (round) ALL corners of a polyline with the given radius. CAD does the math.

tool_signatures.name: fillet_solid
tool_signatures.description: Round edges of a 3D solid: edges = [[x,y,z], ...], ONE point lying ON each edge to round. Printed parts need this - a sharp inside corner is where the part cracks. The edge nearest the camera wins, so set the view (view_3d) when the target is hidden behind the part. Check the result with solid_volume.

tool_signatures.name: fit_viewport
tool_signatures.description: Fit the model into a region of a sheet: measures what is drawn, picks the largest STANDARD scale that fits, then sizes the viewport to the drawing instead of to the region. Returns the scale it chose and why.

tool_signatures.name: flatshot_view
tool_signatures.description: Auto-generate a 2D drawing view (block) of ALL 3D solids, projected from direction (front/top/right/left/back/iso), lower-left corner placed at (x,y). Model in 3D, get the 2D view for free. Returns block handle+size.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity
tool_signatures.description: Raw DXF data of an entity by handle.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_counts
tool_signatures.description: Instant census: entity count per type (cheap; call this FIRST to understand a drawing).

tool_signatures.name: get_extents
tool_signatures.description: Bounding box of the whole drawing or of one layer: cheap spatial check, no screenshot.

tool_signatures.name: get_selection
tool_signatures.description: What the user has currently selected in the GUI (count, handles, types, layers). Enables 'do X on what I selected'.

tool_signatures.name: get_variable
tool_signatures.description: Read a system variable (e.g. CLAYER, DIMSCALE).

tool_signatures.name: graph_build
tool_signatures.description: Read the 2D geometry as a CONNECTIVITY GRAPH and cache it: curves whose ends meet (within tol) become one node, so the drawing can be asked questions instead of read. Reports separate networks, junctions, total length, and the open ends - and for every open end checks whether it actually lands on another curve (a T-junction, fine) or on nothing (a real break, which on a schematic is the defect you were looking for). tol=None (the default) makes the joining tolerance EMERGE from this drawing's own endpoint distances by the max-jump rule, and the report states the value used - pass a number only to override what the drawing says. window=[x1,y1,x2,y2] limits it to one drawing area, layer to one layer. Lengths are exact (arcs and bulges included), in drawing units.

tool_signatures.name: graph_trace
tool_signatures.description: Follow the network from a point through the graph_build cache: how many curves hang together with it, their total length (a take-off), and the open ends inside that network. Answers 'what is downstream of here' and 'is this the same run as that' without reading the drawing. Rebuild with graph_build if the drawing changed - this reads the cached index, and says so if it cannot find one.

tool_signatures.name: hatch_circle
tool_signatures.description: Hatch a circular area (creates the circle boundary + HATCH).

tool_signatures.name: hatch_islands
tool_signatures.description: HATCH the outer closed polygon SKIPPING the island polygons (hatch around holes). outer=[[x,y],...], islands=[[[x,y],...],...].

tool_signatures.name: hatch_polygon
tool_signatures.description: Fill a closed polygon with a real HATCH entity (pattern ANSI31, SOLID, ...).

tool_signatures.name: hole_report
tool_signatures.description: Probe every hole of a part and say which are actually OPEN. holes=[{name,x,y,z,axis,r,len}]: a probe cylinder (radius r SMALLER than the hole's, length len) is grown from (x,y,z) along axis X/Y/Z and intersected with a throwaway copy of the part - material found means the hole is blocked, and the volume says by how much. Born from a part that reached a printable state with four screw holes silently filled by an earlier union: a drawing lies about its holes unless something physically probes them. All probes run in one round-trip; the part is never modified.

tool_signatures.name: insert_block
tool_signatures.description: Insert a block (or .dwg file) at (x,y); rotation in degrees.

tool_signatures.name: insert_symbol
tool_signatures.description: Place a library symbol by NAME OR BY WHAT YOU CALL IT: 'bocchetta di ripresa', 'recuperatore', 'sifone' all resolve through the library's synonym dictionary. Layer and scale come from the library index, so the symbol lands coloured and sized correctly without anyone remembering the convention (symbols are drawn for the index's reference scale; pass scale_denominator=100 for a 1:100 plan). Loads the block from the library DWG if the drawing does not have it yet. Use list_symbols to see what exists.

tool_signatures.name: join_entities
tool_signatures.description: Join touching lines/arcs/polylines into one polyline (first handle = source).

tool_signatures.name: layer_info
tool_signatures.description: Per-layer report: object count, color, linetype, frozen/locked.

tool_signatures.name: leader
tool_signatures.description: Leader arrow: points at (x,y) [the feature], text lands at (end_x,end_y). For callouts like '4x D10'.

tool_signatures.name: list_blocks
tool_signatures.description: List block definitions in the drawing.

tool_signatures.name: list_documents
tool_signatures.description: Every drawing open in the CAD, marking the one the tools are acting on, with entity count, unsaved changes and read-only state.

tool_signatures.name: list_entities
tool_signatures.description: List entities (type, handle, layer), paginated; optional type/layer filter (wildcards ok). Use get_entity_counts first on big drawings.

tool_signatures.name: list_layers
tool_signatures.description: List layers with colors.

tool_signatures.name: list_symbols
tool_signatures.description: What the symbol library offers: block name, Italian and English description, category and real size. Filter by category (unita/distribuzione/canali/terminali/regolazione/accessori) or leave empty for all. Use this before insert_symbol when you do not know what exists.

tool_signatures.name: memory_disable
tool_signatures.description: Turn the drawing's memory journal OFF, cleanly.

tool_signatures.name: memory_enable
tool_signatures.description: Turn ON the drawing's autonomous memory journal.

tool_signatures.name: mirror_entities
tool_signatures.description: Mirror entities across the axis (x1,y1)-(x2,y2). Draw half, mirror the rest. handles=['selection'] uses the GUI selection.

tool_signatures.name: move_3d
tool_signatures.description: Move an entity in 3D by (dx,dy,dz); handle='selection' moves the user's GUI selection. move_entity only shifts in the XY plane.

tool_signatures.name: move_all
tool_signatures.description: Move ALL entities by (dx,dy).

tool_signatures.name: move_entity
tool_signatures.description: Move entity by (dx,dy); handle='selection' moves the user's GUI selection.

tool_signatures.name: offset_entity
tool_signatures.description: Offset a curve by distance toward the side of point (toward_x,toward_y). CAD does the math.

tool_signatures.name: overhang_report
tool_signatures.description: Will this part print without supports, and which way up is best? Reads the STL mesh (no CAD needed) and measures the area that overhangs past limit_deg from the build plate, how much of that is flat ceiling (the bridges), the worst angle and the height where the trouble starts - then scores all six axis orientations so you can see whether simply flipping the part removes the problem. Areas are mm2. build_dir is the direction layers stack in ('z+' means the part prints as it is modelled, 'z-' upside down). Note this measures FACES, not spans: a flat ceiling area of zero means nothing bridges, but a large one does not say whether it is one wide bridge or many narrow ones.

tool_signatures.name: polygon
tool_signatures.description: Regular polygon: center, number of sides, circumscribed radius, rotation degrees.

tool_signatures.name: purge_drawing
tool_signatures.description: Purge unused layers, blocks, linetypes, styles from the drawing.

tool_signatures.name: redo
tool_signatures.description: Redo the last undone operation.

tool_signatures.name: regen
tool_signatures.description: Regenerate the view.

tool_signatures.name: render_view
tool_signatures.description: Render the drawing to a clean PNG (no UI chrome) for visual inspection. Pass a window (x1,y1,x2,y2) to frame a region; omit for current view.

tool_signatures.name: revolve_profile
tool_signatures.description: Revolve a CLOSED 2D profile around axis (x1,y1)-(x2,y2) by angle degrees (turned parts).

tool_signatures.name: rotate_3d
tool_signatures.description: Rotate entities around ANY axis: the line (x1,y1,z1)->(x2,y2,z2), by angle degrees (right-hand rule). This is how you swing a part about a hinge - rotate_entity can only turn around Z.

tool_signatures.name: rotate_all
tool_signatures.description: Rotate ALL entities around a base point by angle degrees (CCW).

tool_signatures.name: rotate_entity
tool_signatures.description: Rotate one entity (or 'selection') around a base point by angle degrees (CCW). Turns around Z only - for any other axis use rotate_3d.

tool_signatures.name: rounded_rect
tool_signatures.description: Rectangle with rounded corners (raccordato), single polyline.

tool_signatures.name: run_command
tool_signatures.description: Run any BricsCAD command; tokens list, "" = Enter. The command name is checked to exist before anything is sent. Prefer dedicated tools when they exist.

tool_signatures.name: run_lisp
tool_signatures.description: Eval AutoLISP code (multi-line and multiple expressions OK); set (setq *MCPRES* ...) to return data.

tool_signatures.name: save_as_dwg
tool_signatures.description: Save the drawing as DWG (2018) to path. Says so explicitly if the drawing is open read-only - typically a stale .dwl lock file left by a crash, which otherwise fails with nothing but 'Function cancelled'.

tool_signatures.name: save_drawing
tool_signatures.description: Save the active drawing where it already lives. Confirmed by DBMOD returning to 0, which is the only thing that proves a write happened.

tool_signatures.name: scale_all
tool_signatures.description: Scale ALL entities from a base point by factor.

tool_signatures.name: scale_entity
tool_signatures.description: Scale one entity (or 'selection') from a base point by factor.

tool_signatures.name: select_by
tool_signatures.description: Select+highlight entities by type and/or layer (wildcards ok: layer='MUR*'). Returns handles; user SEES the selection.

tool_signatures.name: select_window
tool_signatures.description: Select+highlight by rectangular area: crossing=false only fully-inside, true also touching. Optional type/layer filter.

tool_signatures.name: set_current_color
tool_signatures.description: Set current entity color (ACI code; 256=ByLayer).

tool_signatures.name: set_current_layer
tool_signatures.description: Set current layer (created with color and optional lineweight in MM if missing). Line weight is what separates a drawing from a sketch: walls 0.50, visible edges 0.35, dimensions/hatching 0.18.

tool_signatures.name: set_dim_style
tool_signatures.description: Appearance of NEW dimensions: text height, arrow size, decimal places, overall scale.

tool_signatures.name: set_entity_props
tool_signatures.description: Change properties of an entity (or 'selection'): layer, color (ACI, 256=ByLayer), linetype.

tool_signatures.name: set_linetype
tool_signatures.description: Assign a linetype to a layer: CENTER (chain, for axes), HIDDEN, DASHED, PHANTOM, CONTINUOUS. Loads it if missing; ltscale>0 sets global linetype scale.

tool_signatures.name: slice_solid
tool_signatures.description: Slice a 3D solid with a vertical plane through 2 points; keep='both' or a point-side 'x,y'.

tool_signatures.name: slot
tool_signatures.description: Slot/obround (asola, oblong hole): rounded-end slot between the two arc centers, given width. Use this for slots - NOT a rectangle.

tool_signatures.name: solid_box
tool_signatures.description: 3D solid box: base corner (x,y,z), sizes dx,dy,dz (dz along Z).

tool_signatures.name: solid_cone
tool_signatures.description: 3D solid cone: base center (cx,cy,z), base radius, height along Z.

tool_signatures.name: solid_cylinder
tool_signatures.description: 3D solid cylinder: base center (cx,cy,z), radius, height along Z.

tool_signatures.name: solid_sphere
tool_signatures.description: 3D solid sphere: center (cx,cy,z), radius.

tool_signatures.name: solid_torus
tool_signatures.description: 3D solid torus: center (cx,cy,z), ring radius, tube radius.

tool_signatures.name: solid_volume
tool_signatures.description: Volume and centroid of a 3D solid.

tool_signatures.name: solid_wedge
tool_signatures.description: 3D solid wedge (ramp): base corner (x,y,z), sizes dx,dy,dz.

tool_signatures.name: sweep_profile
tool_signatures.description: Sweep a closed 2D profile along a path curve -> 3D solid (pipes, rails, gaskets).

tool_signatures.name: tag_entity
tool_signatures.description: Give an entity a semantic ROLE in the drawing's memory.

tool_signatures.name: text_style
tool_signatures.description: Create/set a text style with a font (e.g. isocpeur.ttf for ISO drawings) and make it current.

tool_signatures.name: title_block
tool_signatures.description: Draw the border and an ISO 7200 title block (180x40, bottom right) on a sheet, in SHEET mm. Reads the sheet size itself; returns the measured border.

tool_signatures.name: trim_entity
tool_signatures.description: Trim: remove the portion of the entity at pick point, cut by the cutting entity.

tool_signatures.name: undo
tool_signatures.description: Undo the last N operations (a whole draw_batch counts as ONE).

tool_signatures.name: use_document
tool_signatures.description: Choose which open drawing the tools act on (match on file name or any part of the path). Everything after this call lands there.

tool_signatures.name: view_3d
tool_signatures.description: 3D view: direction iso/iso2/top/front/back/left/right; shade wireframe/hidden/flat/gouraud. Zooms extents.

tool_signatures.name: view_plan
tool_signatures.description: Back to flat 2D view (top, wireframe, zoom extents). Use after 3D work.

tool_signatures.name: world_report
tool_signatures.description: What is in this drawing, what changed, and is the memory still true.

tool_signatures.name: zoom_extents
tool_signatures.description: Zoom to drawing extents.

tool_signatures.name: zoom_window
tool_signatures.description: Zoom to a rectangular window.
